scripts.build: bun run check && bun run fonts:template && vite build
scripts.build:ellipse: bun run check && bun run fonts:ellipse && vite build --mode origami-ellipse
scripts.build:norm: bun run check && bun run fonts:norm && vite build --mode vector-p-norm
scripts.fonts:template: uv run --offline --with fonttools --with brotli python -I scripts/subset_fonts.py --target template
scripts.fonts:ellipse: uv run --offline --with fonttools --with brotli python -I scripts/subset_fonts.py --target origami-ellipse
scripts.fonts:norm: uv run --offline --with fonttools --with brotli python -I scripts/subset_fonts.py --target vector-p-norm
